temporal_caption: At 0:00 the video opens on a driver's-eye view of a grey, fog-choked two-lane road with visibility cut short just ahead; the vehicle cruises steadily forward as broken lane dashes stream toward the camera. Around 0:02 a faint, indistinct shape materializes at the center of the ego lane, ambiguous within the fog. By 0:03 the shape resolves into the unmistakable silhouette of a small, motionless child standing directly in the vehicle's path. From 0:03 to 0:05 the child figure grows steadily larger and clearer while the ego vehicle maintains its unchanged cruising speed, closing the distance without any braking or steering, ending on the tense, unresolved approach. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Continuous low hum of the vehicle's engine and tires on wet asphalt, muffled and dampened by the heavy fog. Faint wind noise and the subtle whir of the drivetrain. No music, no alerts, and no braking sounds—an unsettling calm underscores the vehicle's failure to react to the hazard ahead.
